purpose: Machine-readable architecture evidence package - NOT a final architecture decision. final_architecture_status is explicitly UNRESOLVED per Section 70.

positive_evidence: PPG-DaLiA: IMU cut HR MAE ~23% vs capacity-controlled PPG-only baseline
candidates.replication: ATTEMPTED_BLOCKED (GalaxyPPG, independent device family - blocked by data access this sprint, protocol frozen and ready)
candidates.burden_known: IMU co-located with PPG in the same wristband - near-zero marginal burden (established)
candidates.contact_module_impact: single wristband module already assumed for PPG; IMU adds no new contact region
candidates.key_uncertainty: Whether the effect reproduces on an independent device/subject family (GalaxyPPG) - currently unresolved, not negative

candidates.contact_module_impact: frontal headband module would need to add EOG-capable electrode placement beyond EEG-only
candidates.key_uncertainty: Cross-dataset (HMC) replication status - being handled on Claude's line, not resolved here
